description: Generate a brand-new cover image (a finished event flyer) for an event from a TEXT prompt — describe the vibe, palette, imagery, and energy. We render it server-side (no image upload from you needed — works even when you can't pass a file) and set it as the event's cover; the event's name becomes the flyer's hero title by default. Counts against the monthly AI-image limit. Target a live event you host (event_id) OR an unclaimed draft (draft_id + edit_token) to iterate on the picture BEFORE publishing — the draft's cover carries over when it goes live. Needs a connected account.
name: generate_event_cover
title: Generate Event Cover
